Subject: Q4 runtime & platform headcount request — 3 roles (IC + Senior IC)

Team —

Following our roadmap planning, I'm requesting approval to open three headcount requests focused on runtime & platform for Q4. These are high-priority hires tied directly to capacity, availability, and our next set of customer SLAs. Summary below; packet attached.

1) Runtime Engineer (Mid IC, L4) — 1 FTE
   - Focus: latency and continuous batching improvements for hosted API
   - Est. comp band (total comp target): $160k — $200k

2) Platform Engineer (Mid-Senior IC, L5) — 1 FTE
   - Focus: autoscaling and dedicated pool orchestration for Dedicated product
   - Est. comp band: $210k — $270k

3) Senior Runtime Engineer (Senior IC, L6) — 1 FTE
   - Focus: kernel selection, quantization paths, and cross-region routing policies
   - Est. comp band: $300k — $380k

Justification / impact:
- These roles reduce token-cost by enabling KV-prefix caching and better batching for 3 pilot customers (estimated $250k annualized saving once shipped).
- Address long-standing reliability debt that has caused three P0 escalations this year.
- Support Dedicated capacity growth we committed to enterprise buyers; two deals in negotiation specify specific latency SLOs.

Budget ask:
- Net incremental fully loaded cost (on-target) ~ $720k/year; target hires distributed in US West & US East (2 remote-west, 1 remote-east).

Attachments: headcount_packet_q4.pdf (packet, role descriptions, hiring plan), comp_bands_runtime.xlsx

Requested next steps:
- Approval in principle to create the reqs and post to recruiting by Oct 12.
- Finance & Recruiting sync to confirm cost center and cadence.

Happy to discuss on a quick call.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Runtime Engineering
